reason: The picture shows liver cells taking glucose from the blood and joining it into a store.
expectation: The liver cells will store some of the meal's glucose as a carbohydrate.

effect: The result confirmed that liver cells join some glucose into a carbohydrate store that can later be broken down for fuel.
reaction: It was useful to see that glucose remains in the blood while some is stored.

mostWorthwhile.text: Combining the glucose-containing blood with liver cells showed how a meal can provide fuel for later, not just immediately.

leastWorthwhile.text: The chapter ended after one very predictable combination, so there was little opportunity to explore.

surprise.text: Nothing particularly surprised me; the liver-cell picture had already shown the glucose being joined into a store.

arbitrary.text: No action felt arbitrary: the picture and goal made the pairing clear.

continue.text: I might continue to see how the stored carbohydrate gets used between meals, but this short chapter alone did not offer much of a gameplay hook.
